content.help: Activating a LIVING npc. Disabled = the vanilla pickpocket screen. Backpack out only = the panel appears only while the backpack is drawn. Always on = pickpocket with empty hands (the panel floats on the NPC, so it never needed the bag in hand). A dead body always uses the loot overlay instead.

Activating a container, or a dead body. Disabled = the vanilla container menu (use this if another container-menu mod conflicts). Backpack out only = the panel appears only while the backpack is drawn. Always on = containers open the panel with empty hands.
The button that CONFIRMS what you are pointing at: tabs, item slots, page arrows, utility buttons, popup buttons, and TAKE EVERYTHING. Default: Trigger. Must differ from the grab button.

The button that GRABS: pull an item out into your hand, rearrange slots, and deposit into a container. Default: Grip. Must differ from the select button; if you set them the same, grab reverts to its default.
